endorsements.name: Luis Martín Liras
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-32453
endorsements.description: SITEL CAP/PRX firmware version 5.2.01 allows an attacker with access to the local network, to access via HTTP to the internal configuration database of the device without any authentication. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability in order to obtain information about the device´s configuration.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.5)

endorsements.label: CVE-2021-32454
endorsements.description: SITEL CAP/PRX firmware version 5.2.01 makes use of a hardcoded password. An attacker with access to the device could modify these credentials, leaving the administrators of the device without access.
